points.description: Method and approach: Correct application of KCL and consistent sign convention for power.

levels.says: Minor inconsistency in current direction definition or power mapping.
Major failure to apply KCL or define current directions, requiring significant interpretation.

points.description: Equations and sign use: Correct KCL equations and power formulas (p = vi) with correct source values.

levels.says: One error in KCL signs or source value mapping.
Multiple errors in equations or incorrect power sign convention applied throughout.

points.description: Calculation and arithmetic: Correct numerical solution of currents and power values.

levels.says: Arithmetic slip or minor unit conversion error.

points.description: Units and labeling: Correct units (W/mW) and clear identification of supplied/absorbed power.

levels.says: Missing units or ambiguous labeling for one source.

points.description: Completeness: All voltage sources addressed with final numerical values and power status.

levels.says: Missing one source or missing final numerical values.
Only equations provided without final values.

rubric.notes: Students start with 100 marks. Deductions are applied based on the rubric categories: Method (M), Equations (E), Calculation (C), Units (U), and Completeness (NC). Ensure that the final power values are clearly identified as supplied or absorbed.
